  Critical (3)

  1. Fail-open hook — research-output-validator.cjs warns but never blocks (exit code always 0). Researcher can ignore warnings entirely.

  3. Retry logic undefined — orchestration-protocol says "max 2 re-research cycles" but doesn't specify who decides gaps or what instructions pass back.

  Moderate (4)

  4. Regex fragile — misses €, £, ¥ currencies; misses formats like "$500k per month"
  5. Bullshit-detector no fallback — gate blocks if agent unavailable
  6. Failure archaeology depth unchecked — checks for section heading only, not 5+ companies
  7. "70% AI disruption" undefined — no objective criteria

  Minor (3)

  8. Empty matcher fires on ALL agents including dev agents (noise)
  9. Source tier vs zone tag confusion (two scoring systems)
  10. Evidence Vault "contradictions" section can be empty and still pass

6.content:
Critical (3)

  1. Fail-open hook — research-output-validator.cjs warns but never blocks (exit code always 0). Researcher can ignore warnings entirely.
  2. Zone tag counting is crude — counts total [K]/[T]/[?] occurrences, not per-claim. One sentence with all 3 tags passes the check.
  3. Retry logic undefined — orchestration-protocol says "max 2 re-research cycles" but doesn't specify who decides gaps or what instructions pass back.

  Moderate (4)

  4. Regex fragile — misses €, £, ¥ currencies; misses formats like "$500k per month"
  5. Bullshit-detector no fallback — gate blocks if agent unavailable
  6. Failure archaeology depth unchecked — checks for section heading only, not 5+ companies
  7. "70% AI disruption" undefined — no objective criteria

  Minor (3)

  8. Empty matcher fires on ALL agents including dev agents (noise)
  9. Source tier vs zone tag confusion (two scoring systems)
  10. Evidence Vault "contradictions" section can be empty and still pass
